facts.confirm: Price and availability confirmed by Zippy

Home.enquiryIntro: Choose a car, branch and times. We show the requested duration and an estimate where rates are published — then you send the enquiry on WhatsApp.
Home.fleetTitle: Five cars. Each one a separate unit.
Home.fleetIntro: Specifications, photographs and rates appear as soon as Zippy Car Rental confirms them.

1.title: Choose a car
1.body: Pick one of the five cars, or choose “Any available car”.

2.title: Pick branch and times
2.body: Select your pickup branch and pickup and return times in IST.

3.title: Send on WhatsApp
3.body: WhatsApp opens with your enquiry written. You press Send.

4.title: Zippy confirms
4.body: Zippy replies to confirm availability and the final price.

Home.aboutBody: Zippy Car Rental rents Maruti Suzuki cars for self-drive in Pune, Maharashtra. Every enquiry is answered personally, so you get the final price and availability directly from Zippy.
Home.branchesIntro: Maps load only when you ask for them. Directions open in Google Maps.
Home.ctaBody: Prepare your enquiry in under a minute. Zippy confirms the details with you.
